
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /archaeology  (/arch, /dead)               │
  │  Dead Code Archaeology                      │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Find dead code, zombie functions, and unused imports.

  Usage:
    /archaeology
    /archaeology clean

  Details:
    Scans your project for:
    
      • Unused imports
      • Dead functions never called
      • Zombie code (commented out blocks)
      • Unreachable code paths
    
    Use 'clean' for interactive cleanup.

  Examples:
    $ /archaeology
    $ /arch clean

  Related: /complexity  /stress
